messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2 PAGE: p99 tail latency surge + streaming stalls in eu-west-2 (router/lb path). Auto-alert: p95 280ms->460ms, p99 1.7s->4.8s, streaming stalls +180% in 8m :rotating_light:
Aisha: oncall ack. Jumping in to triage now. Any immediate customer error reports?
Devon: seeing partial responses and long-lived streaming frames timing out. Ingress shows sudden stickiness to az-b instances starting ~1745560600.
Miguel: dashboards: https://dash.re/redwood/eu-west-2/routing?range=20m — correlate with recent routing policy beta rollout.
Leah: infra snapshot: no CPU/GPU saturation. Memory/KV cache evictions spiked for a few nodes -> likely hotspot.
Sven: checked router logs, relevant lines:
```
2026-02-15T12:03:14Z router WARN assign_pref_local: policy=router.policy.beta-weight key=shard:0x7c2 score_local=0.92 score_remote=0.11
2026-02-15T12:04:01Z router INFO route_move: key=shard:0x7c2 -> nodegroup=eu-west-2-a pool=pool-1
```
Sven: prefer-local heuristic in beta-weight is aggressively favoring local AZs for mid-cardinality keys.
oncall-sre: @Aisha primary. @Devon run mitigation steps.
Aisha: NetOps/Eng Runtime please confirm whether lb-eu-west-2-a reported local connection queuing or ejection events.
NetOps: quick excerpt from lb-eu-west-2-a:
```
2026-02-15T12:05:23Z lb INFO conn_queue: depth=112 threshold=50
2026-02-15T12:05:30Z lb INFO soft_evict: target=node-az1-03 reason=conn_queue_backpressure
```
NetOps: soft evictions present but not wholesale ejections. Rebalancer shifted ~15% weight into az-a during the rollout window.
Devon: immediate mitigations Ill apply: 1) rollback router.policy.beta-weight -> router.policy.stable, 2) enable cross-az spill for streaming traffic, 3) apply temporary key-level QPS caps for hotspots. Executing rollback now.
Devon: rollback command:
```
POST /internal/router/policy/deploy
{
  "target":"router.policy.stable",
  "force":true
}
# deployed at 1745561502
```
Miguel: initiating hotkey throttle for shard:0x7c2 and top offenders:
```
rctl qps --target=key --key=shard:0x7c2 --limit=60
rctl qps --target=key --key=shard:0xa4f --limit=80
```
Leah: I'll prime the KV cache and enable prefix caching for the top hot shards to reduce backend fetches: `kvtool prime --shard shard:0x7c2 && cachectl prefix-on shard:0x7c2`
Eng Runtime: watching streaming frame drop and "stall_duration_ms" histogram. Early signal: p99 dropped from 4.8s -> 2.3s within 3m of rollback start. Streaming stalls down ~55%.
Aisha: good. NetOps, keep an eye on lb backpressure metrics — we don't want cascading soft evictions.
NetOps: copy. Enabled cross-az spillover at 1745561620 and throttles applied. No new ejections.
Sven: note: router.policy.beta-weight bug: prefer-local multiplier didn't normalize by key cardinality. When a few mid-card keys spike, the multiplier concentrated them into one AZ. Reproduced locally with synthetic traffic.
Miguel: hotkey scan (top 6): shard:0x7c2=1.6k rps, shard:0xa4f=720 rps, shard:0x113=540 rps, others <400. Will attach traces to ticket.
Customer Success: two enterprise customers reported degraded streaming quality; support ticket 8764 opened. No public outage posted yet.
Aisha: short customer comms draft: "We've mitigated a routing policy rollout issue in eu-west-2 that concentrated high-traffic keys onto a small set of nodes, causing elevated tail latency and streaming degradation for some customers. We rolled back the policy and applied mitigations; monitoring shows recovery. We'll follow up with an RCA." Any additions?
Customer Success: please mention dedicated customers in message and that we will offer post-incident follow-up.
oncall-sre: severity stays SEV-2. Maintain mitigation until p99 < 800ms for 30m. Handoff: @Aisha on until 1745562200, then @Devon covers next 4h.
Devon: mitigation status at 1745562100: p99 ~640ms, streaming stalls near baseline. Continuing to monitor.
Leah: created internal bug RWI-4333: "beta-weight: prefer-local multiplier not normalized by key cardinality" assigned to Eng Runtime with tests. Also adding e2e to prevent future regressions.
Eng Runtime: agreed. Patch and rollout plan: fix normalizer, add hotspot detector that prevents >x% weight shift into an AZ for keys with rps > threshold.
Miguel: also applied cache eviction soft clear on overloaded nodes to rebalance working set: `kvtool soft-evict --node node-az1-03 --shard shard:0x7c2`
Aisha: checklist for post-incident: 1) full timeline, 2) SLA minutes per affected customer, 3) root-cause analysis and proposed code fix, 4) monitoring/alert tuning, 5) postmortem and customer note.
Customer Success: we'll coordinate customer comms once RCA ready.
Devon: update @1745563999: stable at p99 590ms, streaming stalls resolved, keeping mitigations for 15 more minutes then will start removing throttles carefully. Writing RCA now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigation accepted; severity remains SEV-2 until p99 SLO satisfied for 30m. Incident doc: https://incidents.re/redwood/1745561234
Aisha: thanks team 44aa. Good triage and quick rollback.
Devon: handing off monitoring to on-call rotation. I'll post RCA draft in 2h.
